2026-11-25 phase 1 (schema): migration 000043 adds tenant_id to the 18 verified extension tables and rebuilds five natural unique keys tenant-first. The T01 list was wrong: biz_preflight_control is a test-only table; biz_application, obs_alert_rule, obs_alert_event, obs_notification_channel and obs_notification_log were missed.

Finding: T04 delivered schema only. No business code uses tenant.Scoper/TenantOwnerID, and cicd/filedist/cmdb/deploy/k8s still mount DataScopedGroup, so tenant_id is not yet enforced on reads or writes anywhere outside observability. Phase 2 (read scope, write owner, route-group switch with registered permission routes, async tenant identity) is not done.
